name: EM Carry-to-Vol: BRL, MXN, ZAR, IDR Ranking with VIX Regime Filter
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, and IDR by carry-to-vol ratio (EM interbank rate minus USD Fed Funds, divided by 63-day realized FX volatility). Cross-sectional ranking updated daily. Forward return analysis (21d) by carry-to-vol tercile, split into low-VIX (VIX < 20) and high-VIX (VIX >= 20) regimes using VIXCLS from FRED, to test whether the carry-to-vol premium is more reliable when global volatility is contained. FX returns are inverted so positive = EM currency appreciation vs USD.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL: BRL, MXN, ZAR, IDR — WHICH HAS THE BEST RISK-ADJUSTED CARRY?
# =============================================================================
# Assets: USDBRL, USDMXN, USDZAR, USDIDR (USD per EM unit)
# FX convention: pair falls = EM strengthens → invert return so positive = EM appreciation
# Carry = EM interbank rate - USD Fed Funds rate (% per annum, monthly FRED → ffilled daily)
# Vol = 63-day annualized realized volatility on the FX pair close
# Carry-to-vol = carry / (vol * 100)  [carry in %, vol in decimal → normalize to same scale]
# Tercile = cs_rank_quantile > 0.667 (top), < 0.333 (bottom), else middle
# VIX regime: low = VIXCLS < 20, high = VIXCLS >= 20 (FRED daily series)
# Forward returns: 21d EM FX return (inverted), split by VIX regime
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary FX data (market_data_source = USDBRL / USDMXN / USDZAR / USDIDR per asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
bar_ts = index()

# --- Realized FX volatility (63-day, annualized decimal, e.g. 0.15 = 15%) ---
fx_vol_63d = volatility(period=63)(close)

# --- Interest rates: EM interbank rates (monthly FRED, ffilled to daily) ---
# Brazil: IRSTCI01BRM156N — Immediate interbank rate (% per annum)
# Mexico: IRSTCI01MXM156N — Immediate interbank rate (% per annum)
# South Africa: IR3TIB01ZAM156N — 3-month interbank rate (% per annum)
# Indonesia: IRSTCI01IDM156N — Immediate interbank rate (% per annum)
# USD: DFF — Fed Funds Effective Rate (daily, % per annum)
brl_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')().result)
mxn_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01MXM156N')().result)
zar_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')().result)
idr_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01IDM156N')().result)
usd_rate = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')().result)

# --- VIX regime (VIXCLS from FRED — daily, deeper history than common_indices) ---
vix = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')().result)
is_low_vix  = is_valid(vix) and vix < 20.0
is_high_vix = is_valid(vix) and vix >= 20.0

# --- Select the correct EM rate for this asset context ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDZAR')()
em_rate = brl_rate if is_brl else (mxn_rate if is_mxn else (zar_rate if is_zar else idr_rate))

# --- Carry = EM rate - USD rate (both in % per annum) ---
carry = em_rate - usd_rate

# --- Carry-to-vol ratio ---
# carry is in % (e.g., 10.5), vol is decimal annualized (e.g., 0.15 = 15%)
# Normalize: carry / (vol * 100) → dimensionless ratio
# Guard: only compute when vol is valid and positive (S02)
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(fx_vol_63d) and fx_vol_63d > 0.0, carry / (fx_vol_63d * 100.0))

# --- Cross-sectional rank (percentile 0.0 to 1.0, higher = better carry-to-vol) ---
ctv_rank = cs_rank_quantile(ascending=True)(carry_to_vol)

# --- Tercile classification ---
is_top_tercile = is_valid(ctv_rank) and ctv_rank > 0.667
is_bottom_tercile = is_valid(ctv_rank) and ctv_rank < 0.333
is_mid_tercile = is_valid(ctv_rank) and ctv_rank >= 0.333 and ctv_rank <= 0.667

# --- Forward EM FX returns (inverted: positive = EM appreciation) ---
fwd_ret_21d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=21)(close)
fwd_ret_63d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# --- Filter forward returns by tercile × VIX regime ---
# Low-VIX regime (VIX < 20)
top_fwd_21d_low  = where(is_top_tercile and is_low_vix,  fwd_ret_21d)
mid_fwd_21d_low  = where(is_mid_tercile and is_low_vix,  fwd_ret_21d)
bot_fwd_21d_low  = where(is_bottom_tercile and is_low_vix, fwd_ret_21d)

# High-VIX regime (VIX >= 20)
top_fwd_21d_high = where(is_top_tercile and is_high_vix, fwd_ret_21d)
mid_fwd_21d_high = where(is_mid_tercile and is_high_vix, fwd_ret_21d)
bot_fwd_21d_high = where(is_bottom_tercile and is_high_vix, fwd_ret_21d)

# --- Event marker filter: entering top tercile (crossover from below 0.667) ---
entered_top = crossover(ctv_rank, 0.667)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1 — CONTEXT: Carry-to-vol ratio over time (all 4 currencies)
# =============================================================================

cs_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio Over Time — Which EM Currency Offers Best Risk-Adjusted Carry?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Annualized Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Red, Color.Cyan],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='Carry > Vol', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=carry_to_vol)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2 — PUNCHLINE: Current carry-to-vol snapshot (sorted descending)
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Current Carry-to-Vol Ranking — Who Has the Best Risk-Adjusted Carry Today?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    sort_by_value='Descending',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=carry_to_vol)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 3 — LOW-VIX REGIME (VIX < 20): Mean 21d EM return by tercile
# Does carry-to-vol predict returns when global vol is contained?
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Low-VIX Regime (VIX < 20): Does Top Carry-to-Vol Tercile Outperform? Mean +21d Return',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Mean 21d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['Top Tercile', 'Mid Tercile', 'Bot Tercile'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(top_fwd_21d_low, mid_fwd_21d_low, bot_fwd_21d_low))

# =============================================================================
# CHART 4 — HIGH-VIX REGIME (VIX >= 20): Mean 21d EM return by tercile
# Does carry-to-vol still predict returns when global vol is elevated?
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='High-VIX Regime (VIX ≥ 20): Does Top Carry-to-Vol Tercile Outperform? Mean +21d Return',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Mean 21d Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['Top Tercile', 'Mid Tercile', 'Bot Tercile'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=(top_fwd_21d_high, mid_fwd_21d_high, bot_fwd_21d_high))

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE — Carry, vol, carry-to-vol, rank, and forward returns per currency
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='EM Carry-to-Vol: Carry, Vol, Ratio, Rank & Avg Forward Returns',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=4
)(em_rate, usd_rate, carry, fx_vol_63d, carry_to_vol, ctv_rank, fwd_ret_21d, fwd_ret_63d)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS — Top-tercile entries (when a currency crosses into top carry-to-vol)
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Top Carry-to-Vol Entry',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge, title='Carry (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge, title='63d Vol (ann.)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='CS Rank', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='VIX at Entry', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+21d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+63d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(entered_top, carry_to_vol, carry, fx_vol_63d, ctv_rank, vix, fwd_ret_21d, fwd_ret_63d)
